title: Organization encrypted request/result CRUD facade semantics
intent: Make organization browser operations explicitly use encrypted Nostr request/result facade semantics without implying public Nostr-native org read models.
observed_behavior: web/src/lib/stores/orgs.svelte.js sends encrypted operation strings such as orgs.list, orgs.create, and orgs.delete through requestEncryptedResult().
internal/controlplane/encrypted_domain_handlers.go applies repository-backed organization CRUD, membership, invite, and RBAC operations after decrypting kind 5980 requests.
Organization state is not projected as public durable org read-model events.
intended_behavior: Organization UI and docs classify org operations as encrypted 5980/7980 request/result facade semantics.
Inbound encrypted requests validate NIP-01 event integrity before handler dispatch.
Relay OK/AUTH/CLOSED/timeout and encrypted terminal results follow the shared bahia-qtoq lifecycle contract.
Docs do not imply stronger nostr_native org read-model semantics than implemented.
